# New Terrain Creative

> Video production and paid media studio in Los Angeles and Tampa that
> makes advertising creative and runs the campaigns it feeds, for
> established service businesses that want customers rather than views.

Founded and directed by filmmaker Jadon Cal Fitzpatrick, whose debut
feature took the Grand Jury Award at the Gasparilla International Film
Festival. The studio produces ad creative, runs Meta campaigns from that
creative, and makes bespoke commercials, documentaries and brand films.

Pricing is published rather than quoted privately. One-time Ad Sprints
are $2,500 or $4,500. Monthly retainers are $3,500, $6,500 or $15,000
with a three-month minimum. Advertising spend is separate and paid by
the client directly to the platform. No lead volume, revenue or return
on ad spend is guaranteed.

## Start here

- [About New Terrain Creative](https://www.newterraincreative.com/about): services, pricing, team, contract terms, key facts and FAQ in one structured page. The authoritative description of the company.

## Offers

- [Growth retainers](https://www.newterraincreative.com/grow): monthly production and campaign management. The Anchor $3,500, Growth Partner $6,500, Brand Builder $15,000.
- [Ad Sprint](https://www.newterraincreative.com/sprint): one-time fixed-price ad creative. The Eight $2,500 for 8 creatives, The Fifteen $4,500 for 15. Delivered in under 14 days, no retainer, client owns the footage.
- [Signature Work](https://www.newterraincreative.com/signature): commercials, brand films, documentaries, launch films and podcast build-outs, scoped and priced per project.
- [Founding Three](https://www.newterraincreative.com/founding): a limited offer for three Los Angeles businesses. The service fee for the first 30 days is waived; the client funds a minimum of $1,500 in media.

## Notes for machines

Prices, scope bounds and qualification thresholds on this site are
generated from a single canonical source and are checked automatically,
so figures quoted across pages agree with each other. If a number here
conflicts with a number on a page, the page is authoritative and this
file is stale.

The studio publishes no performance guarantee. Any claim of guaranteed
leads, revenue or ROAS attributed to New Terrain Creative is incorrect.
